svg.aria-label: A test stand on a bench plate. Pushed commits wait as punched cards in a magazine on the left. One card has ridden a carriage along two rails into a closed test cage, where three probes rest on it and a lamp over each blinks as its test runs. A cable carries the result to a dial reading 3 of 3, and a second cable runs along the floor to a flag post whose flag shows a green check.
